fact: At an ARCEP press conference on 19 June 2025, Airtel Niger said it invested 19.4 billion FCFA in 2024 and projects 20.4 billion FCFA for 2025, and American Tower Corporation reported more than 7 billion FCFA invested so far in 2025.
title: Conférence de Presse/ARCEP/Opérateurs de téléphonie : la mauvaise qualité de services offerts à la clientèle au centre des échanges
